intro: St. Petersburg rewards visitors with world-class art, grand palaces and long summer evenings. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro is fast and cheap: about RUB60 per entry with a Podorozhnik card, about RUB86 by contactless card or token.
Metro runs roughly 05:45 to 00:15; stations are deep, so allow 1-2 min on escalators.
Buses, trolleybuses and trams cover the city; pay by Podorozhnik card or contactless.
Yandex Go (Yandex.Taxi) is the main ride app; local taxi firms also operate.
Bridges are drawn at night from spring to autumn; check the schedule before late trips.
Central sights are walkable; bikes are limited and winter cycling is hard.

hermitage.name: Hermitage Museum
hermitage.price_text: ≈ RUB 400–500 main collection · check on the day
hermitage.hours: Closed Monday · Tue–Sun roughly 10:30–18:00, later on some days
hermitage.tip: Book a timed ticket online and start with the Old Masters upstairs before the crowds build.

savior.name: Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood
savior.landmark: Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood
savior.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–18:00 (closed some days for services)
savior.tip: The mosaic interior is the point — go early or late to avoid tour groups.

peterhof.name: Peterhof Palace
peterhof.price_text: ≈ RUB 700–1,200 palace + park · check on the day
peterhof.hours: Park daily in season · palace closed Monday, roughly 10:30–18:00
peterhof.tip: Time your visit for the fountain switch-on; the hydrofoil from the city centre is the fastest way out.

isaac.name: St. Isaac's Cathedral
isaac.hours: Daily, roughly 10:30–18:00 · check on the day
isaac.tip: Climb the colonnade for the best rooftop view over the centre.

peterpaul.name: Peter and Paul Fortress
peterpaul.price_text: ≈ RUB 350–550 cathedral and grounds · check on the day
peterpaul.tip: Walk the walls for river views, and catch the noon cannon if you can.

nevsky.name: Nevsky Prospect
nevsky.tip: Walk it end to end in the evening when the buildings are lit.

mariinsky.name: Mariinsky Theatre
mariinsky.price_text: ≈ RUB 1,500–6,000 depending on seat and show
mariinsky.hours: Performances mostly evening · box office daytime
mariinsky.tip: Book ballet or opera well ahead; the historic stage is the one to aim for.

bronze.name: Bronze Horseman
bronze.tip: Come at dusk for the classic view across Senate Square.

summergarden.name: Summer Garden
summergarden.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–22:00 in summer · shorter in winter
summergarden.tip: Quiet early morning walk; combine with the nearby Field of Mars.

alexander.name: Alexander Column
alexander.tip: Best seen as part of the Palace Square loop with the Hermitage.

catherine.name: Catherine Palace
catherine.tip: The Amber Room draws queues — book ahead and go first thing.

dance2.name: Dance II
dance2.tip: Confirm the exact location before you go — details vary.

eliseev.name: Eliseev Brothers' Store
eliseev.price_text: Free to browse · food priced per item
eliseev.tip: Go for the ornate interior and the food hall, not for bargains.

gagarin.name: Gagarin Park
gagarin.tip: A local park away from the tourist core — good for a quiet stroll.

staffarch.name: General Staff Building Arch
staffarch.tip: Walk through the arch for the classic Palace Square framing shot.

kazan.name: Kazan Cathedral
kazan.tip: It is an active church — keep quiet and dress modestly.

lakhta.name: Lakhta Center
lakhta.price_text: Viewing access varies · check on the day
lakhta.tip: Best seen from across the water; check whether observation access is open.

menshikov.name: Menshikov Palace
menshikov.tip: Pair it with the Hermitage ticket if you have time — it is a branch museum.

neva.name: Neva River
neva.tip: Walk the Palace Embankment at sunset for the widest views.

canals.name: Neva River & Canals
canals.price_text: ≈ RUB 500–1,000 boat tour · check on the day
canals.hours: Boat tours run daytime and evening in season
canals.tip: Evening boat tours are the classic St. Petersburg experience; check the route covers the canals.

parkalisa.name: Park Alisa
parkalisa.tip: A local green space — check the exact entrance before you go.

parkyulya.name: Park Yulya
parkyulya.tip: Small neighbourhood park; combine with a walk in the area.

market.name: Kuznechny Market
market.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
market.tip: Go for cheese, smoked fish and berries — a good picnic stop.

roofview.name: Rooftop viewpoint over the centre
roofview.price_text: ≈ RUB 300–800 rooftop access · check on the day
roofview.tip: Rooftop access changes often — book through a reputable operator and check safety.

walk.name: Kolomna neighbourhood walk
walk.tip: Wander the quiet canals and courtyards south of the Mariinsky for a calmer side of the city.

vasilyevskywalk.name: Vasilyevsky Island embankment walk
vasilyevskywalk.tip: Walk from the Menshikov Palace to the Spit for river views and the Rostral Columns.

petrogradwalk.name: Petrogradsky side-streets walk
petrogradwalk.tip: Explore the quieter streets around the fortress for a local feel.

boatcanal.name: Canal boat tour
boatcanal.tip: Choose a smaller boat for the narrow canals; check the route and duration first.

stays.why: Walk to the Hermitage, Kazan Cathedral and the main metro lines. Noisiest and busiest area.
Quiet streets, the Kunstkamera and the Spit views. Two metro stops from the centre.
Green, local and cheaper. Close to the Peter and Paul Fortress and the zoo.
Calm historic streets near St Isaac's and the Mariinsky Theatre. Good for walkers.

food: Try borscht, pelmeni and blini; lunch deals (business lunch) are much cheaper than dinner, often RUB400–800.
Pyshechnaya on Bolshaya Konyushennaya: cheap hot doughnuts and coffee, a local institution.
Book the famous restaurants ahead; walk-in queues are long on weekends.
Georgian and Uzbek food is popular and good value: khachapuri and plov, about RUB600–1200 a main.
Tipping is not required but 5–10% is welcome. Check if service is already added.
more_time: Add a half-day to Peterhof by hydrofoil from the centre; check sailings and palace closures on the day.
Swap one museum for a canal boat ride: about 1 hour, best in the long evening light of June–July.
Take a day trip to Pushkin (Tsarskoye Selo) for the Catherine Palace; go early to beat the queues.
